chapter_title_en: The Heaven-Mending Pill Falls; Nascent Soul Cultivators Reveal Themselves
chapter_seo_title: The Heaven-Mending Pill Ignites a Three-Way Melee – A Record of a Mortal’s Journey Chapter 495
chapter_meta_description: The Heaven-Mending Pill appears, shattering every truce among the Nascent Soul cultivators. Han Li barely survives a killing strike and attempts to flee, only to be pinned down by the Profound Bone Saint. Wan Tianming takes the ultimate gamble.
og_description: Nascent Soul cultivators fight to the brink of soul-ejection over a single pill. Han Li’s escape is cut short by a cold voice from behind the battle lines.
twitter_title: The Heaven-Mending Pill Falls – Mortal’s Journey Ch.495
twitter_description: One pill. Seven old monsters. Zero trust. Han Li is caught in a web he cannot slip, and Wan Tianming is ready to burn his soul for the prize.

lore_anchors.definition: A legendary elixir said to repair a cultivator's Five Elements spiritual roots, referencing the myth of Nüwa mending the sky.
The risky act of a Nascent Soul cultivator sending their soul-infant outside the body; it leaves the original body vulnerable and the infant fragile.
A refined thunder-type treasure powerful enough to threaten other Nascent Soul cultivators; rarely used due to its extreme cost or risk.
A scale-based defensive treasure lent to Han Li by Man Brutal Beard; able to withstand a Nascent Soul strike when augmented by other defenses.
A thousand-year-old undead cultivator existing as a Profound Soul Body; former master of Extreme Yin Island's founder.
A rare spider used by Han Li to probe the Void Heaven Palace seal; killed by the Star Palace elder in the previous chapter.
A barrier surrounding the Heaven-Mending Pill, pulsing with light as if alive.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why didn't Han Li die from the Star Palace elder's sword strike?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The Imperial Scale Armor he wore under his robes reduced the blow, and the jade ruyi's hidden wolf head absorbed most of the attack's power.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did the Profound Bone Saint call Han Li back instead of letting him escape?
cultural_notes_faq.a: His motive is deliberately ambiguous: he may want to use Han Li as a hostage, a diversion, or simply to prevent him from becoming an uncontrolled variable.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Is Wan Tianming really going to use the Heaven-Entwining True Thunder?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He has ejected his Nascent Soul with the thunder pearls in hand, signaling genuine intent—but using it could destroy himself as well, creating a mutual-assured-destruction standoff.
